commands.note: ci:assert-staging refuses outside the staging-ci GitHub environment; the authoritative run is the `verify` check on PR #1592

runtime_proof.note: This lane's runtime claim is a refusal: a delivery path exists and cannot fire. The measured posture of every control is in runtime-health.json. A live-DB run against production is deliberately not performed -- it would require creating a delivery_kill_switch row for official-picks, a production write whose only effect would be to weaken the fail-closed default this lane depends on. The staging live-DB receipt is produced by the `verify` and `Writable DB proof (staging only)` checks on PR #1592 and is harvested at closeout by ops:proof-generate --merge-sha.

queries.name: the governed target holds no kill-switch row in production
queries.method: read-only SELECT against production zfzdnfwdarxucxtaojxm: `select target, killed from delivery_kill_switch order by target`
queries.result: 4 rows: best-bets killed=true, exclusive-insights killed=true, trader-insights killed=true, t1-proof-utv2-1427-kill-switch killed=false. `official-picks` is absent.
queries.significance: DeliveryKillSwitchRepository.isKilled returns true for an unknown target, so the ABSENCE of the row is the kill. The lane deliberately does not create one -- creating it would be a production write whose only effect is to weaken this default.

queries.name: nothing has ever been delivered, or queued, on the governed target
queries.method: read-only SELECT: `select count(*) from distribution_outbox where target = 'discord:official-picks'` and `select count(*) from picks where promotion_target = 'official-picks'`
queries.significance: The shipped posture is measured in production, not asserted from the branch.

queries.name: no production pick carries a delivery authorization record
queries.method: read-only SELECT: `select count(*) from picks where metadata ? 'deliveryAuthorization'`
queries.significance: The authorization key this lane introduces does not yet exist on any persisted row, so no existing pick changes behaviour when the code ships.

queries.name: the two-key path, the brake and the approval transaction, end to end
queries.method: apps/api/src/t1-proof-utv2-1923-human-capper-delivery.test.ts driven against the real in-memory repository bundle -- the same code paths the database bundle implements
queries.result: 25/25 pass. An authorized submission is server-pinned delivery-eligible and parks in awaiting_approval with outboxEnqueued=false; approval with the target disabled enqueues nothing and reports target-disabled; approval with the target released enqueues exactly one row on discord:official-picks.
queries.significance: Operator approval is the only path out of the brake, and it is still subordinate to the kill switch.

queries.name: the client cannot reach the authorization decision
queries.method: a forged metadata.deliveryAuthorization submitted on the capper path and on the unauthenticated path; a client requesting distributionMode delivery-eligible
queries.result: the record is deleted before anything reads it on every source; the request is refused 403 CAPPER_TRACK_ONLY_REQUIRED
queries.significance: Browser/client cannot grant delivery, which is the PM-stated V1 authorization shape.

queries.name: the worker's registry and kill-switch checks, exercised
queries.method: runWorkerCycles with a real InMemoryDeliveryKillSwitchRepository (isKilled fail-closed on unknown), apps/worker/src/worker-runtime.test.ts
queries.result: 70/70 pass, 4 new: a raw discord:<channelId> target is now subject to the kill switch; a released raw channel still delivers and is not registry-refused; the governed human target is killed until released; registry and kill switch are independent.
queries.significance: Closes the discord:<channelId> hole, which previously bypassed the kill switch entirely.

queries.name: the bounded deploy mode, parsed from the real workflow
queries.method: scripts/ci/deploy-parked-mode.test.ts asserting against .github/workflows/deploy.yml source, in both the canary and production blocks
queries.result: 32/32 pass, 7 new. human-capper releases the worker only; SYNDICATE_MACHINE_ENABLED stays false; parked is byte-identical; the mode is unreachable from the SYNDICATE_MACHINE_ENABLED secret (it is a repository variable, so reserved decision 4 is untouched); an unmapped or capper-channel-colliding target map is a hard deploy error.
queries.significance: Containment is not widened, and the PM instruction not to route member picks through DISCORD_CAPPER_CHANNEL_ID is enforced at deploy time, not in prose.

queries.name: every guard has a mutation control
queries.method: withGuardRemoved copies the module with the text between the UTV2-1923 *_START/_END markers deleted, imports the mutant, and asserts it fails open
queries.result: 5/5 controls kill their mutant: forgery guard, enqueue authorization guard, submit brake, requeue guard, target exclusivity guard.
queries.significance: Each control demonstrates the specific failure it prevents rather than merely existing.
